# Anti-AI Slop & Modern UI/UX Guidelines

## Overview
"AI Slop" in web design refers to repetitive, uninspired visual patterns generated by automated models defaulting to cliché aesthetic tropes without structural intent. This document defines the strict rules for avoiding AI slop and building authentic, refined, high-utility user interfaces.

---

## 1. The Anti-AI Slop Rules (What to Avoid vs What to Do)

| Slop Pattern (BANNED) | Why It Is Bad | Intentional Modern Alternative |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Generic Purple/Indigo Mesh Gradient Blobs** | Zero brand identity; creates readability issues and looks like an early 2023 crypto template. | Solid, structured surface tokens with subtle contrast shifts (`#0D0F12` $\to$ `#16191F`), crisp border accents, or monochromatic depth. |
| **Unnecessary Eyebrow Pill Badges** (`✨ THE FUTURE OF XYZ ✨` above every header) | Visual noise that clutters the visual hierarchy and delivers zero semantic value. | Direct, high-impact typography with intentional scale, strong line height, and clear semantic `<h1>` / `<h2>` hierarchy without decorative tags. |
| **Card-in-a-Card Syndrome** (Triple-nested cards with identical `border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/50`) | Cluttered visual weight, wastes padding/margin space, confuses content relationships. | Use divider lines, whitespace separation, table layouts, or single cohesive containers with clean typographic grouping. |
| **Fake Neon Glow Shadows** (`shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(99,102,241,0.5)]` on buttons/inputs) | Distracting, looks amateurish, ruins focus indicator accessibility. | Refined 2-layer ambient shadows (`box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)`) and high-contrast `:focus-visible` rings. |
| **Decorative Floating 3D Orbs / Geometry** | Consumes GPU/CPU resources without conveying any information or user affordance. | Meaningful data visualizations, interactive UI previews, real product screenshots, or crisp SVG architectural diagrams. |
| **Arbitrary Frosted Glass / Backdrop-Blur Everywhere** | Unreadable text when scrolling over varied backgrounds; high composite cost on mobile devices. | Opaque solid surfaces with strict z-index layering and explicit token colors. Reserve `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)` strictly for sticky headers/drawers. |

---

## 2. Intentional Modern Design System Token Architecture

### CSS Design Tokens (Dark & Light Theme Foundation)

```css
:root {
  /* Surface Layers (Light Mode) */
  --surface-base: #FFFFFF;
  --surface-raised: #F8F9FA;
  --surface-overlay: #F1F3F5;
  --surface-sunken: #E9ECEF;

  /* Border Tokens */
  --border-subtle: #E2E8F0;
  --border-default: #CBD5E1;
  --border-strong: #94A3B8;

  /* Text & Content Tokens */
  --text-primary: #0F172A;
  --text-secondary: #475569;
  --text-tertiary: #64748B;
  --text-inverse: #FFFFFF;

  /* Semantic Brand & Accents (Calibrated HSL) */
  --accent-primary: #2563EB;
  --accent-primary-hover: #1D4ED8;
  --accent-primary-subtle: #EFF6FF;
  --accent-success: #16A34A;
  --accent-warning: #D97706;
  --accent-danger: #DC2626;

  /* Elevation Shadows (Multi-layered, Natural Light Physics) */
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
  --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);

  /* Radius System */
  --radius-sm: 4px;
  --radius-md: 8px;
  --radius-lg: 12px;
  --radius-full: 9999px;
}

[data-theme="dark"] {
  /* Surface Layers (Dark Mode - Rich Neutral Slate/Zinc) */
  --surface-base: #0B0D11;
  --surface-raised: #13161C;
  --surface-overlay: #1B1F27;
  --surface-sunken: #07080A;

  /* Border Tokens */
  --border-subtle: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
  --border-default: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  --border-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);

  /* Text & Content Tokens */
  --text-primary: #F8FAFC;
  --text-secondary: #94A3B8;
  --text-tertiary: #64748B;
  --text-inverse: #0F172A;

  /* Semantic Brand & Accents */
  --accent-primary: #3B82F6;
  --accent-primary-hover: #60A5FA;
  --accent-primary-subtle: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12);

  /* Elevation Shadows */
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 8px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 24px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 6px 12px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}
```
